title: cho.json
description: The settings of a CHO workspace, read by the cho command-line tool.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for an editor.

version.description: The version of the format of this file.

runtime.description: The runtime of the workspace: what runs its projects, and installs their packages.

appsDir.description: The folder a new project is created in.

projects.description: The projects of the workspace, by name.

kind.description: What the project is: a web application (@chojs/web), or a command-line tool (@chojs/command).

root.description: The folder of the project, from the root of the workspace.

entry.description: The file that runs the project, from its folder.

module.description: The file that exports the root module of the project, as AppModule, from its folder.
